fallacyScan.detail: Separate frozen topology-specific block estimands were analysed; no pooled topology effect was substituted.
Inference is explicitly at the complete matched-block level; lane and process rows are not independent n.
No outcome-based sample filtering was permitted; all 36 frozen complete blocks entered each estimand.
The frozen primary analysis contains no post-treatment covariate adjustment.
Not applicable: the endpoint is continuous batch wall time, not a diagnostic classification rate.
Not applicable: blocks were not selected by extreme outcome and the design is not an extreme-score pre/post study.
All 36 frozen blocks and all 864 processes passed the acquisition hard gates; no completer-only subset was created.
P1-P4 were prespecified and Holm-adjusted; S1-S2 are separately gated and Holm-adjusted.
Estimator, test, multiplicity, interval companion, bootstrap seed/draw count and outputs were frozen before batch outcome parsing.
Claims are bounded to controlled within-algorithm worker scaling; causal CCD-mechanism attribution is prohibited.
Not applicable to the randomized, fixed-condition execution contrast.

multipleComparisonControl: Holm P1-P4; gated Holm S1-S2; conservative Bonferroni one-sided simultaneous decision bounds

reproducibility.method: single authorized deterministic formal execution plus frozen synthetic known-answer validation
reproducibility.reasonNotRerun: the analysis contract authorizes one formal execution and no overwrite; no second formal-data run was performed
